capabilities: Match notes against ordered rules on tags, properties, titles and paths
Move matching notes to destination folders built from placeholders like date, property, tag or title
Preview proposed moves for a folder or the whole vault with checkboxes before running them
Undo the last 20 move batches one step at a time
Move edited or renamed notes automatically two seconds after the edit
extras: Warns that Obsidian's 'Automatically update internal links' setting should be turned on so links update after moves; moves use Obsidian's own rename. Rules from Auto Note Mover are not imported and must be re-entered.
intentEvidence: The rules work the same way (first match wins, a tag or a title regular expression picks the folder), plus properties and paths, a preview before bulk moves and undo.
problem: Obsidian leaves filing notes into folders to manual dragging, so notes pile up in inbox or root folders unless you sort them by hand.
summary: Rule-based file mover that sorts notes into folders by tags, properties, titles or paths, with a preview and undo before any bulk move.
